# Aim

To portion out tissue water content into gut and gonad water content and determine if crickets are storing water in their gut lumen.


# Setup
```{r}
#| include: false
source("setup.R")
```


# Load data

Calculate:

* Staring mass
* Transfer mass
* Whole animal wet mass (end mass)
* Wet carcass mass
* Wet gut mass
* Wet gonad mass
* Dry carcass mass
* Dry gut mass
* Dry gonad mass

```{r}
gg_data <- read_excel("data/Desiccation 2025/guts and gonads/GutsAndGonads_massdata.xlsx") %>% 
  mutate(Whole_animal_wet_mass = wet_whole_body - carcass_tube,
         Start_mass = case_when(Time_treatment == 0 ~ Whole_animal_wet_mass,
                              .default = start_cricket - start_container),
         Rehydrated_transfer_mass = ifelse(Time == 24, transfer_cricket - transfer_container, NA),
         wet_carcass_mass  = wet_carcass - carcass_tube,
         wet_gut_mass = wet_gut - gut_tube,
         wet_gonad_mass = wet_gonad - gonad_tube,
         dry_carcass_mass  = dry_carcass - carcass_tube,
         dry_gut_mass = dry_gut - gut_tube,
         dry_gonad_mass = dry_gonad - gonad_tube,
         total_dry_mass = dry_carcass_mass + dry_gut_mass + dry_gonad_mass,
         Percent_change = case_when(Time == 0 ~ NA,
                                    Time == 24 ~ 100 - (Rehydrated_transfer_mass / Start_mass) * 100,
                              .default = 100 - (Whole_animal_wet_mass / Start_mass) * 100),
         Desiccation_time = ifelse(Time == 24, 18, Time),
         Total_water_content = ((Start_mass - total_dry_mass) / Start_mass) * 100,
         # Water lost during desiccation (%)
         Relative_water_loss = (Percent_change /  Total_water_content) * 100,
         # Calculate water loss rates
         Mass_change_rate = ifelse(Time == 0, NA, Percent_change / Desiccation_time)) # %/h)
  
# Calculate water content
gg_data <- gg_data %>% 
  mutate(
    # Total amount of water in body
    Body_water = Start_mass - total_dry_mass,
    # Water lost during desiccation
    Lost_water = Start_mass - Whole_animal_wet_mass,
    # Water in all tissues post-desiccation
    Tissue_water = Whole_animal_wet_mass - total_dry_mass,
    carcass_water = wet_carcass_mass - dry_carcass_mass,
    gut_water = wet_gut_mass - dry_gut_mass,
    gonad_water = wet_gonad_mass - dry_gonad_mass,
    haem_water = Tissue_water - carcass_water - gut_water - gonad_water)

# Calculate proportion relative to total amount of body water
gg_data <- gg_data %>% 
  mutate(
    # Water lost during desiccation
    Desiccation_water_prop = -((Lost_water / Body_water) * 100),
    # Water in tissue post-desiccation
    Tissue_prop =  ((Tissue_water / Body_water) * 100),
    carcass_water_prop = (carcass_water / Body_water) * 100,
    gut_water_prop = (gut_water / Body_water) * 100,
    gonad_water_prop = (gonad_water / Body_water) * 100,
    haem_water_prop = (haem_water / Body_water) * 100)

# Remove 182 outlier constipated male
gg_data <- filter(gg_data, Cricket_ID != 182)

# Removed starved control group
gg_data <- filter(gg_data, Time_treatment != "0_starved")
```

```{r}
# Standardise changes relative to controls
baseline <- gg_data %>% 
  group_by(Sex) %>% 
  filter(Time == 0) %>% 
  summarise(mean_tissue = mean(Tissue_prop),
            mean_carcass = mean(carcass_water_prop),
            mean_gut = mean(gut_water_prop),
            mean_gonad = mean(gonad_water_prop),
            mean_haem = mean(haem_water_prop)) %>% 
  data.frame(row.names  = c("F", "M"))

gg_data <- gg_data %>% 
  mutate(diff_tissue = ifelse(Sex == "Female", Tissue_prop - baseline["F",2],
                             Tissue_prop - baseline["M",2]),
         diff_carcass = ifelse(Sex == "Female", carcass_water_prop - baseline["F","mean_carcass"], carcass_water_prop - baseline["M","mean_carcass"]),
         diff_gut = ifelse(Sex == "Female", gut_water_prop - baseline["F","mean_gut"], gut_water_prop - baseline["M","mean_gut"]),
         diff_gonad = ifelse(Sex == "Female", gonad_water_prop - baseline["F","mean_gonad"], gonad_water_prop - baseline["M","mean_gonad"]),
         diff_haem = ifelse(Sex == "Female", haem_water_prop - baseline["F","mean_haem"],
                             haem_water_prop - baseline["M","mean_haem"]))
```

Derive:

* Water content (mg)
* Total water content (mg); sum of all water content
* Haemolymph content (mg); remaining water


```{r}
rehydration_guts <- gg_data %>% 
  filter(Time == 24) %>% 
  mutate(Percent_change = 100 - (Rehydrated_transfer_mass / Start_mass) * 100,
         Percent_change_recovery = (Whole_animal_wet_mass / Start_mass) * 100) %>% 
  select(Cricket_ID, Sex, Time_treatment, Percent_change, Percent_change_recovery) %>% 
  mutate(Start_Percent = 100,
         Percent_change = 100 - Percent_change) %>% 
  pivot_longer(contains("Percent"), names_to = "Timepoint", values_to = "Change") %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = "Guts",
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Start_Percent", "Percent_change", "Percent_change_recovery"))) 

save(gg_data, rehydration_guts, file = "data/Desiccation 2025/guts.Rdata")
```

```{r}
Percent_change_mean <- gg_data %>% 
  group_by(Time, Sex) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(Percent_change),
            se = sd(Percent_change) / sqrt(n()),
            cv = (sd(Percent_change) / mean) * 100)
knitr::kable(Percent_change_mean, digits = 3)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = gg_data, aes(Time, Percent_change, shape = Sex, colour = Sex), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  geom_line(data = Percent_change_mean, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(data = Percent_change_mean, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), 
             size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = Percent_change_mean, aes(Time, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se,
                                     colour = Sex), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Wet mass lost (%)", limits = c(0, 30), expand = c(0,0), breaks = seq(0, 150, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery"))
```

# Relative difference in body water

```{r}
diff_water <- gg_data %>% 
  group_by(Time, Sex) %>% 
  summarise(.groups = "drop",
            n = n(),
            # Tissue
            mean_tissue = mean(diff_tissue),
            se_tissue = sd(diff_tissue) / sqrt(n()),
            # Gut 
            mean_gut = mean(diff_gut),
            se_gut = sd(diff_gut) / sqrt(n()),
            # Gonad
            mean_gonad = mean(diff_gonad),
            se_gonad = sd(diff_gonad) / sqrt(n()),
            # carcass
            mean_carcass = mean(diff_carcass),
            se_carcass = sd(diff_carcass) / sqrt(n()),
            # Haem
            mean_haem = mean(diff_haem),
            se_haem = sd(diff_haem) / sqrt(n()),
            # Total loss
            mean_loss = mean(Desiccation_water_prop),
            se_loss =  sd(Desiccation_water_prop) / sqrt(n()))

diff_pal <- viridis::viridis(4, begin = 0.75, end = 0, option = "C")
diff_pal2 <- viridis::viridis(3, begin = 0.8, end = 0, option = "D")

p_diff_tissues <- ggplot(gg_data, aes(x = Time)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  # gut
  # geom_point(aes(y = diff_gut, colour = "Gut"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_gut, colour = "Gut"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_gut, colour = "Gut"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_gut - se_gut, ymax = mean_gut + se_gut, colour = "Gut"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # gonad
  # geom_point(aes(y = diff_gonad, colour = "Gonad"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_gonad, colour = "Gonad"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_gonad, colour = "Gonad"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_gonad - se_gonad, ymax = mean_gonad + se_gonad, colour = "Gonad"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # carcass
  # geom_point(aes(y = diff_carcass, colour = "Carcass"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_carcass, colour = "Carcass"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_carcass, colour = "Carcass"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_carcass - se_carcass, ymax = mean_carcass + se_carcass, colour = "Carcass"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # total
  # geom_point(aes(y = Desiccation_water_prop, colour = "Total loss"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.3, stroke = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_loss, colour = "Total loss"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_loss, colour = "Total loss"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_loss - se_loss, ymax = mean_loss + se_loss, colour = "Total loss"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # haem
  # geom_point(aes(y = diff_haem, colour = "Haemolymph"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.3, stroke = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_haem, colour = "Haemolymph"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_haem, colour = "Haemolymph"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_haem - se_haem, ymax = mean_haem + se_haem, colour = "Haemolymph"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # # tissue
  # geom_point(aes(y = diff_tissue, colour = "tissue"), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  # geom_line(aes(y = mean_tissue, colour = "tissue"), data = diff_water, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # geom_point(aes(y = mean_tissue, colour = "tissue"), data = diff_water, size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # geom_errorbar(data = diff_water, aes(ymin = mean_tissue - se_tissue, ymax = mean_tissue + se_tissue, colour = "tissue"), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Tissue", values = c("Gut" = diff_pal[3], "Gonad" = diff_pal[2], "Carcass" = diff_pal[1], "Total loss" = diff_pal2[1],"Haemolymph" = diff_pal2[2]), labels = c("Carcass", "Gonad", "Gut", "","")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Body water lost (%)", limits = c(-20, 5), expand = c(0,0), breaks = seq(-50, 30, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery")) +
facet_grid(Sex~.)

p_diff_tissues
```

Effect of sex but no interaction

```{r}
anova(lm(diff_gut ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))
anova(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))
anova(lm(diff_carcass ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))


pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_gut ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey") 
pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey") 
pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_carcass ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey") 

emmeans(lm(diff_gut ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1) 
emmeans(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1) 
emmeans(lm(diff_carcass ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1) 
```

* Gonad does not change over time but has the largest differences
* Gut and carcass changes over time

```{r}
carcass_mod <- lm(carcass_water_prop ~ Time_treatment + Sex, data = gg_data[gg_data$Time_treatment!="0_starved",])
```

## Relative carcass water
```{r}
gg_data <- gg_data %>% 
  mutate(standard_carcass_water = ifelse(Sex == "Female",
                                        carcass_water/mean(gg_data[gg_data$Sex == "Female" & gg_data$Time == 0,]$carcass_water),
                                        carcass_water/mean(gg_data[gg_data$Sex == "Male" & gg_data$Time == 0,]$carcass_water)))

std_mean_carcass <- gg_data %>% 
  group_by(Time_treatment, Sex, Time) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(standard_carcass_water),
            se = sd(standard_carcass_water) / sqrt(n()),
            cv = (sd(standard_carcass_water) / mean) * 100)
knitr::kable(std_mean_carcass, digits = 3)

rel_carcass <- ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(data = gg_data, aes(Time, standard_carcass_water, shape = Sex, colour = Sex), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
   # line for starved crickets
  geom_line(data = std_mean_carcass, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = std_mean_carcass, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex),
             size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = std_mean_carcass, aes(Time, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se,
                                     colour = Sex), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative carcass water", limits = c(0.4, 1.6), expand = c(0,0), breaks = seq(0, 2, 0.2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery")) 

rel_carcass_mod <- lm(standard_carcass_water ~ Time_treatment + Sex, data = gg_data)
# No interaction
anova(rel_carcass_mod)

# Compare with 0 starved
emmeans(rel_carcass_mod, ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "0") 

emmeans(rel_carcass_mod, ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  pairs(adjust = "Tukey")

```

```{r}
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery")) +
facet_grid(~Sex)

p_diff_tissues
```

```{r}
anova(lm(diff_gut ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))
anova(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))
anova(lm(diff_carcass ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data))


pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_gut ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey") 
pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey") 
pairs(emmeans(lm(diff_carcass ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment), adjust = "Tukey")

emmeans(lm(diff_gonad ~ Time_treatment + Sex, gg_data), ~ Time_treatment) %>% 
  contrast(method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1)

```

* Gonad does not change over time but has the largest differenes
* Gut and carcass changes over time

# Gut

```{r}
gut_water_mean <- gg_data %>% 
  group_by(Time, Sex) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(gut_water),
            se = sd(gut_water) / sqrt(n()),
            cv = (sd(gut_water) / mean) * 100)
knitr::kable(gut_water_mean, digits = 3)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = gg_data, aes(Time, gut_water, shape = Sex, colour = Sex), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA) +
  geom_line(data = gut_water_mean, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(data = gut_water_mean, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), 
             size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = gut_water_mean, aes(Time, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se,
                                     colour = Sex), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Gut water (mg)", limits = c(0, 70), expand = c(0,0), breaks = seq(0, 150, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery"))
```

```{r}

  geom_line(data = gut_water_prop_mean, aes(Time, mean, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +

             size = 2, shape = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = gut_water_prop_mean, aes(Time, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se,
                                     colour = Sex), width = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Gut water (% body water)", limits = c(0, 20), expand = c(0,0), breaks = seq(0, 150, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (h)", breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18, 24), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "18 h + \n6 h recovery"))

p_gut
```

* No interaction.
* Males decrease in gut water content only after prolonged desiccation.  
* Males are not replenishing gut water after rehydration
